pageDescription: Font Awesome enriches the visual language with a diverse set of iconic elements that elevate the FMS Design System, providing users with a comprehensive and integrated toolkit for crafting exceptional user interfaces.

fontAwesome.title: Icons: Fontawesome 6 Pro
fontAwesome.body: All Icons in FMS will be using Fontawesome 6 Pro.

guidelines: Icons should always be in monochromatic colour in order to pass the same colour contrast ratio as typography.
Centre-align icons when they are positioned alongside text.
Icon-only buttons will display the labels as tooltips.

usage.title: Usage
usage.intro: System icons are best used in a design to enhance user experience and aid in navigation. They should be employed when they can effectively communicate information or actions in a more visually engaging and intuitive manner compared to text alone. Below are some examples of icon usage in the FMS system.
